Definitions (per run; implemented in analyse, line 610):
- Live columns = non-dropped columns of X. Centre every non-intercept column; S = Xc'Xc.
- VIF_j = [S^-1]_jj · S_jj. Rank-deficient X: compute S^+ from the eigendecomposition (relative tolerance 1e-9 of the largest eigenvalue); VIF is infinite for columns in the support of the null space ("aliased"), and [S^+]_jj·S_jj for the others (must stay finite and equal the least-squares 1/(1−R²)).
- R² of column j on a block G (each event term separately; motion + censoring spikes; confound regressors; drift cosines + intercept): s_jG S_GG^-1 s_Gj / S_jj.
- Joint contributors: standardized coefficients of the regression of j on all other columns, b_k = −[S^-1]_jk / [S^-1]_jj · sd_k / sd_j; report the top 5 by |b|.
- Correlation: reuse DesignExports.correlationMap.
Why blocks and contributors matter: pairwise r cannot explain multi-column collinearity (gamble main effect VIF ≈ 24.9 is explained by accept + reject together, r ≈ 0.97, not by either alone; DMS Sample vs early Delay FIR bins).
Verified numbers: page VIF vs least-squares agreed to ≤ 6e-14 for every column, both runs, all five studies (critiques/m2b-methods.md; audit/m2b-methods/recompute.py, dump.json). Under rank deficiency (DMS + duplicate Probe) non-aliased VIF matched least squares to ~1e-14 (critiques/m4b-methods.md).
API sketch (names are yours): DesignDiagnostics.forRun(design, run): vif: Map[ColumnId, Vif], blockR2(column): Seq[(Block, Double)], contributors(column, k), correlation; Vif = Finite(v) | Aliased.
Acceptance: fixtures from the five studies (rebuild columns as in build(), line 566, or from dumped matrices) reproduce the page values within 1e-10; one rank-deficient fixture.
